thread:
jia: kicking off a small canary for the FP8 kernels on H100 + L40S for the new transformer-XL variant. goal: enable throughput wins without accuracy regressions. any early heads-up?
neil: great, what config are you testing? kernel + mixed-precision or full fp8 path?
jia: mixed-precision path: qkv matmul + attention in FP8, rest in FP16. AWQ for activations in the INT8 path comparison. running with batch sizes 1/8/32 to capture latency and throughput.
sara: quick note — we saw subtle attention head saturation on H100 when sequence > 2048 last time. watch for per-head KL drift. :rotating_light:
matt: can you paste the run command? I want to run a local replicate on L40S.
jia: sure — snippet below:
```
# canary run
python run_infer.py \
  --model gptx-small-v2 \
  --device h100,l40s \
  --quant fp8_mixed --awq_offload false \
  --batch-sizes 1,8,32 \
  --seq-len 1024,2048 \
  --measure perplexity,latency,mem
```
carla: thanks. any eval suite? small heldout + 3 prompt families (QA, summarization, code)?
jia: yes: eval_short.jsonl (QA), eval_summarize.jsonl, eval_code.jsonl. comparing FP16 baseline, FP8-mixed, AWQ-GPTQ int8. automated metric: avg ppl + token-level exact match for QA.
neil: initial L40S run finished — quick numbers: FP16 ppl 12.4, FP8-mixed ppl 12.6 (+1.6%), AWQ ppl 13.2 (+6.5%). latency median: FP16 48ms@1, FP8 42ms@1, AWQ 38ms@1 but cpu decode overhead higher.
sara: 1.6% ppl delta is borderline but maybe within acceptable. check per-task breakdown — where is the drift?
matt: I just saw logs with a small NaN in KV cache on H100 when sequence 2048 and batch 8 on FP8 path. stack trace points to `attention_module::scale_accum`.
carla: can you dump the failing input? we need a repro test for bisect.
jia: dumping now. logs: ```
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] ERROR attention_module: scale_accum produced inf for head 3
ctx id: 0x7f3b4c, seq=2048, batch=8
input prefix len 1980
```
neil: hmm that looks like activation saturation, maybe exponent overflow in FP8 kernel for certain head scales. try enabling activation clipping heuristic: `--fp8-act-clip 8.0` and re-run.
jia: re-ran with `--fp8-act-clip 8.0` — no NaN for that case, ppl stays ~12.62. perf cost ~ +2% latency.
sara: can we add a fallback policy: if NaN or inf in kernel, route request to FP16 variant automatically? we should avoid 500s in prod.
matt: we already have a fallback mechanism but it only triggers on runtime crash. need earlier detection in kernel to return a flag and let runtime switch. I'll open a tiny PR.
carla: also check mixed-precision accumulation order. on L40S our kernel uses a tiling that changes rounding order vs H100 implementation, that can explain tiny numeric deltas.
neil: good point — we saw a consistent bias on certain heads where tiling boundary intersects sparsity pattern. we should test with `--tile-override 128` to harmonize.
jia: added that for next wave. running a micro-benchmark to compare per-head dot outputs across devices.

# results summary (canary 1)
- models: gptx-small-v2
- configs: FP16 baseline, FP8-mixed (default kernels), FP8-mixed (clip8 + tile128), AWQ-int8
- dataset: eval_short.jsonl (3k samples)

metrics:
- FP16 ppl 12.40, latency 48ms@1
- FP8-mixed default ppl 12.62 (+1.8%), latency 42ms@1
- FP8-mixed clip+tile ppl 12.50 (+0.8%), latency 43ms@1
- AWQ-int8 ppl 13.18 (+6.3%), latency 38ms@1

notes: FP8 with clipping + tile harmonization recovers most of the delta, small perf hit vs raw FP8 but still wins vs FP16 on latency. AWQ gives best raw latency but accuracy loss > 6% and higher CPU postprocessing cost.

carla: can we capture token-error heatmap? i want to see if errors cluster at long-range dependencies.
jia: added heatmap capture. early look shows increased token errors in the last 40 tokens of seq for QA prompts with rare entities.
matt: let's add a canary label and route 5% of production traffic to FP8-mixed with auto-fallback to FP16. config: `canary: fp8_mixed, percent: 5, fallback: fp16`. ops-bot will enforce.

deploy-bot: Canary configured: `fp8_mixed` -> 5% traffic. Fallback target: `fp16`. Monitoring hooks: ppl_delta, error_rate, latency_p95.
sara: also wire a regression alert if ppl increases > 2.5% or QA exact-match drops > 1.5% over baseline.
neil: good. follow-up tasks: 1) PR for kernel early-detect + error flag (matt), 2) add tile-override test matrix (carla), 3) add heatmap aggregation to eval pipeline (jia), 4) canary rollout config (matt/ops).
jia: I'll post the baseline artifacts and raw logs to the canary folder: s3://redwood-canaries/1982345678/
carla: thanks — please also add a short runbook note on what to do if fallback rate > 1% (rollback and bisect kernels).
matt: will write the runbook. aim for an emergency rollback script: `rcp rollback fp8_mixed --to fp16`.
